name: Max Levchin
current_role: Co-founder, chairman and CEO of Affirm
summary: Max Levchin co-founded Confinity, the company that became PayPal, with Peter Thiel in 1998 and was its chief technology officer until eBay bought it in 2002. He then founded the media-sharing company Slide, sold to Google in 2010, was an early backer and longtime chairman of Yelp, and co-founded the buy-now-pay-later lender Affirm, which he has led as CEO since 2014.
